creaseMethod: Each saved horizontal body row4-7: front left/right separately in +X and back in -X. A strict interior local crest uses nearest local trough on each side; boundaries also reported explicitly. Depth is projected outward distance from linearly interpolated bracket baseline at crest Y. Boundary brackets do not certify a complete fold. Track row/column identity across all four rows; report every crest, not only passing ones.
limitations: Custom sampled geometric diagnostic, not measured historic fabric or curvature-normal prominence. Large gaps/undersampling and broad contour can affect depth; report them. Do not equate seeded four waves or whole row range with final crease acceptance.
hemMethod: Compare row8 to row7 for matched back/front columns, project movement along inward X. Report all columns; whole-body taper influences this metric, so inspect native side silhouettes too.
